reason: The application has no capability that deletes a customer record. It publishes only observation capabilities (customers.list@1, customers.lookup@1, billing.contact@1) and one consequential capability, customers.register@1, whose contract is to register a new customer. Deletion is a new effect with its own inputs, authorization (e.g. a customers.write or customers.delete permission), declared failures such as unknown customer, and verification. It also affects dependents like billing.contact@1. Providing it requires adding a new capability with its own contract, e.g. customers.delete@1. Changing an existing implementation cannot do that, and repurposing customers.register@1 or any observation capability to delete records would break their contracts. Next step: the application owner defines and publishes a customers.delete capability contract. Its implementation can then be proposed and verified against that contract.
